title: Fatigue's Questing!
description: A survival-focused questing mod built around a journal-driven progression system. Instead of relying on vanilla advancements.
body:
**Fatigue’s Questing!**

A survival-focused questing mod built around a journal-driven progression system. Instead of relying on vanilla advancements, players follow dedicated quest paths for getting started, crafting, exploration, combat, strange carved-pumpkin discoveries, and long-term endgame goals.

Open the Quest Journal to browse connected quest nodes, track objectives, check required items, and claim rewards once your inventory meets the requirements. Quest progress is per-player, completions are announced in chat, and claimed quests stay visible so the whole journey feels like a proper playthrough map.

Also includes a custom Glowstone Golem encounter tied into the questline, with its own item reward path.
